surprise strike.name: Surprise Strike: Effect: gain a bonus on this attack roll against a foe denied its Dexterity bonus to AC

take 'em alive.name: Take 'em Alive: Activation: this attack deals only nonlethal damage and has no secondary effects (such as poison); Effect: no [[-4]] penalty for dealing nonlethal damage with a weapon that normally deals lethal damage, plus a bonus on this attack and damage roll that grows with level

turnabout.name: Turnabout: Activation: in place of an attack of opportunity, attempt a dirty trick combat maneuver check against the foe that provoked it by attacking or casting a spell; Effect: on a success, in addition to the usual dirty trick options, redirect the foe's attack or spell to a new target or area it could have chosen

twisting fear.name: Twisting Fear: Activation: whenever this attack causes the target to gain the shaken, frightened, or panicked condition; Effect: the target also takes nonlethal damage equal to your reduced hidden strike damage, as the stress wears on its body (a creature can't take this damage more than once per round); stalker vigilante only

up close and personal.name: Up Close and Personal: Cost: swift action; Activation: attempting an Acrobatics check to move through an opponent's space during a move action; Effect: make a single melee attack against that opponent; if the Acrobatics check succeeds, this attack deals hidden strike damage as if the target were unaware of you, otherwise it deals the hidden strike damage you'd deal against a target denied its Dexterity bonus to AC; stalker vigilante of at least 4th level only

vortex splash.name: Vortex Splash: Cost: full-round action; Activation: while in rain or standing waist-deep in water; Effect: attempt a single dirty trick combat maneuver or feint (your choice per target) against each foe adjacent to you
